public_ci.blocker_reason: The workflow was pinned to an older Mirai revision and must be rerun against the exact release candidate.

limitations: The checker corpus is intentionally supplied by an exact Mirai checkout and is not bundled into the checker package.
An inherited stale MIRAI_REPO can make the suite fail before semantic checks; clean-room commands must bind the candidate checkout explicitly.
Publication on a branch proves public reproducibility of the exact revision but is not a PyPI release or external human endorsement.
